Alembic migration script to add timezone to the "last_used_at" column in the "v2_api_key" table.

# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic for a SQLAlchemy-managed database. It defines an upgrade and a downgrade function to modify the `last_used_at` column in the `v2_api_key` table. The [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function changes the column type from `postgresql.TIMESTAMP()` to `sa.DateTime(timezone=True)`, adding timezone support. The [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function reverses this change, removing the timezone support by reverting the column type back to `postgresql.TIMESTAMP()`. The script includes revision identifiers to track the migration history.
